name: health
description: Family health management system on Google Drive: per-member medical archive with a strict documentary pattern, personal health reports (PDF, Spanish), printable facts-only medical packages for appointments, appointment booking through the insurer's channels (coverage check, evidence- and distance-ranked doctors, WhatsApp bot or portal, email confirmation, calendar), appointment guides (one decision, three questions), private management dashboards, clinical-trials surveillance, 3D imaging explainers built locally from DICOM (own reading, Blender model, interactive viewer), and a recurring audit — usable from desktop, web, and mobile against the same files.
